platinum.summary: Earn all 55 listed trophies, including the individual cleanup objectives.
platinum.approach: Follow the story stages in sequence, handle the Chapter 1 warning before leaving that chapter, then work through collectible and activity cleanup. Check the in-game trophy list after each objective; finish by confirming the platinum unlocks.
